EXHIBIT #1, THREE DAY NOTICE TO PAY RENT OR QUIT, I.D. 9:50 A.M. THE COURT AFTER HEARING THE TESTIMONY ORDERED JUDGMENT FOR PLAINTIFF AGAINST BOTH DEFENDANTS AGAINST LINDA HILL BY STIPULATION AND AGAINST DEFENDANT ROBERT SMITH AFTER TRIAL BY COURT WHEREIN ROBERT SMITH FAILED TO APPEAR FOR RESTITUTION OF THE PREMISE AT 626 POLK STREET #214 SAN FRANCISCO, CA. EXECUTION STAYED UNTIL 1/3/94 HOWEVER SHERIFF MAY POST PRIOR TO THAT DATE.
